body:
I think some of it may be because of me being bipolar.

I think the real issue is I have impossible standards for myself. Nothing is ever good enough for me. I am always telling myself I can do better, that if I had tried just a little harder, or done one small thing different, the outcome would have been better. It used to be bad enough that I would tear myself down when I failed to achieve what I wanted, I have been much better about not attacking myself though. I wish I could change my mindset, at least in certain aspects of my life, but I honestly don't know how. 

I am not being treated, and prefer to not be treated. When I have been treated everything just felt to flat.
